title: MNCS promotion authority map
description: Pinned trust binding consumed by the owner-native promotion evaluator. Maps each check id to the exact provider string and semantic authority that may satisfy it, so a structurally valid check-result with the right id from the wrong producer cannot satisfy a boundary requirement. Derived from pinned family producer descriptors; the map file's own digest is preserved in the promotion result. MNCS owns this contract.

provider.description: Exact expected check-result provider string for this check id.

authority.description: Semantic authority that owns this requirement. Must equal the boundary entry's authority.

repository.description: Producer repository, carried for attribution. Transport does not verify it beyond echo.
